_comment: The graphs inside fhir-harness's `collab` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of folio-assistant-core's `collab/graph.json`. Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "collab"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry), and it `requires` `cat-harness.sdlc` (owner, 2026-11-13): off in every layer unless that layer lists `fhir-harness.collab` in its own `enableSubgraphs`.
name: collab

directories.description: The FHIR IG processes that run on the work plan and the delivery process, in the concern group `content` as under `processes/`: the FHIR IG pipeline (`l3-fhir-pipeline.bpmn`), its incremental build (`ig-incremental-build.bpmn`) and the IG AST delta review (`ig-ast-delta-review.bpmn`).
